name: {cls[name]}_EXCEPTED_WHITE_LONG
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. Q-series sheet R9-Q04_3 '... excepted (4 lines)' supplementary plate (2022/2023); the three class lines are the sheet's dashed boxes, generated for the complete three-line classes the sheet lists (entries with '[COUNCIL]' or '... m' blanks left out). The class lines are set in Series C per the sheet's note 'for longer names use Series C font' (CONSTRUCTION is 476 wide at 50 D against the 420 inside the border, 404 at 50 C); EXCEPTED stays 50 D. Vary values are dicts (l1 / l2 / l3 / name / leg). Size A 450 x 380 generated (B 600 x 500, C 750 x 630 also tabled), r 25, c 5 / d 15. Chain e 45 / f 50D / g 30 / f / g / f / g / f EXCEPTED / e 45 = 380: cap tops 45, 125, 205, 285. Word gaps within a line the font's word space. Black on white.
